selection: Max F0.5 among candidates with TP >= v1 default, FP < v1 default, merged predictions and references affected <= v1 default, on validation only; earliest tie kept.
checkpoint_dtype: FP16; evaluation reloads those values into FP32
training: Full parent windows, ignore-aware losses, flips/quarter rotations, explicit negative scenes; layer4 adaptation begins after epoch10 at LR 2e-06; heads LR 2e-05; AdamW wd1e-4; gradientclip1; AMP; batch1.
development_history: Second validation-only round: the initial three USA-initialized experiments failed the unchanged promotion gate. This round retains local v1 knowledge with a lower learning rate. No new test predictions informed either round.
caveat: Provisional assistant labels of visible roofs, not human truth or verified houses. One capture; new geographic test is not independent acquisition. Old validation is reused for model selection.
